name: Pretrained person detector for the tracking handoff
origin: General COCO-pretrained checkpoint; not trained by this project
distribution: Included as yolo11n.pt in the repository and standalone submission package. The README setup command can restore a missing copy; runtime requires a local checkpoint.
threshold_selection: Demonstration default; not optimized on labeled campus-person validation data.
limitations: Person class 0 belongs to a separate stream from item class 0 (machete).
No campus-person accuracy or tracking performance is claimed.
Does not identify people, assign track IDs, or associate weapons with people.
Two detectors require additional compute; combined live throughput must be measured on the target machine.
